added.summary: Writes a prop named after the folder: the processed GLB standing on its base, its import settings (levels of detail and a baked collider for og cook) and its convex hulls, and reports its size in metres, scale, triangles, texture memory before and after, open and non-manifold edges before and after the repair, levels and the look's facts. --max-texture PX shrinks its maps.

added.member: og model place --size, og model process --size
added.summary: --size x,y,z (GLB axes, 0 leaves an axis free) scales a model by the one factor nearest every axis given and reports what is left per axis.
A length without a unit (--height 1.2) is metres; m, cm and mm still name their unit.
Take a mesh's import settings (boulder.glb.ogt) for the model they set.
